messages:
maya: Heads up — PR #21711 wants to land. linux CI ✅, mac e2e stuck in queue (pos ~42). If we don't land before Friday blackout we'll need a follow-up patch. Can @samir or @riley give thumbs on the approach? :pray:

samir: what's failing on mac? flakes or infra?

maya: not failing — just queued. logs show no green runs yet. ci-bot said position 42. I can run a targeted mac smoke locally but need a merge slot.

ci-bot: Build PR#21711 — linux: passed (job 12). mac-e2e: queued (position 42). see https://ci.redwood/in/21711

riley: I can try a night-shuttle slot at 00:30 PT. ops_lead — is shuttle open overnight? any blackout in APAC?

ops_lead: Night shuttle available but requires oncall+2 approvals. Also need canary guard for rollback. If we schedule at 00:30 PT, set `ROLLBACK_TAG=pr-21711` and ping oncall.

maya: good call. samir can you +1 on tests? riley can you take rollout owner for shuttle? I'll queue the rebase and flag the canary.

samir: Reviewed code — small lint nit but nonblocking. +1 for merge after rebase.

riley: I'll own the rollout. tagging oncall: @sre-oncall please be ready 00:30 PT. I'll post the merge command in #eng-oncall before landing.

sre-oncall: oncall here — noted. will monitor and ready to rollback.

maya: thanks all. Plan: rebase now -> run targeted mac smoke -> if green, schedule night shuttle 00:30 PT. I'll update PR and add the `shuttle-window` label.

samir: ack.

riley: also add `canary:2` in the rollout config so we start small.

maya: added labels and comment: `Night shuttle 00:30 PT — riley rollout owner — samir +1`.

ci-bot: PR#21711: rebase started by maya. mac-smoke trigger requested.

maya: will follow up in morning if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
